notes.title: Pre-release update
notes.content:
Version 1.20
Added Cut Scenes.
Added Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, German and French.
Gaming capacity increased to 339 MB.
Test play completed.

Version 1.10
Add aerial battles. Gaming capacity increased to 264 MB.

Previous versions can be played by right-clicking on the game name from the STEAM app and selecting Beta from the properties.
